about: pokebonkdb.org is an independent fan site for planning a run. Compare all 151 Pokémon and the 79 League partners, look up attacks and fusions, and check items, vitamins and Lab costs before spending Stardust. Guides cover a first clear, PokéBonk Survival and PokéBonk Co-op. The Builds page keeps the Survival combinations we tested.

It is a free browser survival game with Kanto’s Pokémon. Choose a League partner, collect experience, and pick attacks, vitamins and items as the horde closes in. Classic is a standard clear. Survival measures how long you stay alive. Co-op is a shared room with revives and portals. The Play page opens the game. This site does not host it.
faqs: Is PokeBonk free, and where do I play?
PokéBonk 3D is a free browser game. The Play page opens it and explains the controls and browser requirements. pokebonkdb.org provides guides and planning tools; it does not host the game.
/play
Which Pokémon should I start with?

Bulbasaur helps recover from repeated small hits, Squirtle adds armor and shield, and Charmander rewards Fire damage with a conditional low-health bonus. Pick the passive that helps with the problem ending your runs, then keep the same setting while learning it.
/guides/beginners-guide
Can all 151 Pokémon start a run?

The Pokédex includes 151 Kanto species. Only 79 are selectable League partners; other forms belong to evolution paths. Use the League partner filter to compare starts and the evolution information to see what comes later.
/pokedex
How do attacks fuse?

Open a fusion entry in Attacks to see its ingredients. Both moves need level 8 at Bill’s Machine. Signature pairs take priority, then reactions, type fusions and MissingNo. Weather, boosters and existing fusion moves cannot be ingredients.
/wiki/attacks#fusions
What should I buy in the Lab first?

Start with the problem you can identify: surviving the opening, keeping a needed attack, or finding useful offers. Compare the relevant stat, slot and offer-control upgrades. The calculator adds the prices between your current level and a target; later levels do not all cost the first-level price.
/wiki/lab
Does the tier list show the strongest endgame build?

Our recommendations compare solo Classic openings using the v0.8.62 starting kits, not measured win rates or the strongest endgame build. Each partner has a placement reason and a weakness. Arrange all 151 species yourself to record your judgment for another mode.
/tier-list
Which version and date do the lists cover?

Gameplay lists cover v0.8.62. The Season 2 Global top 100 boards were recorded on October 28, 2026, including appearances, regional scores and projected prizes. Open the game for subsequent placements.
/about#independence
Where are my rankings, checklist and vitamin plans saved?

They stay in this browser’s localStorage, separately from the game. They do not sync between devices. Clearing site data removes them; the tier board also supports JSON export. Vitamin plans have three base slots per partner.
/privacy-policy
